    def compare_at_operations(self, document, *, variations=None, serials=(0, 8191, 8192)):
        """The unchanged branch runs with original admitted value/field closures."""
        case, observations = self, []
        reference = composite._Elaborator._reference_record_operation
        selected = composite._Elaborator.lower_record_operation

        def compare(owner, ins, actual, declared, env, ops, consume, outputs, record_field):
            initial_serial, initial_env = owner.serial, dict(env)
            held = {id(item): (item, item.consumed) for item in [*env.values(), *actual]}
            choices = [(deepcopy(ins), actual, declared)]
            if variations:
                choices.extend(variations(owner, ins, actual, declared))
            def restore():
                env.clear(); env.update(initial_env)
                for item, consumed in held.values():
                    item.consumed = consumed
            def observed(call, current_ops):
                trace = []
                resolve, parameters = owner.types.resolve, owner.parameters
                def tracked_resolve(*args, **kwargs):
                    trace.append(('resolve', deepcopy(args), deepcopy(kwargs)))
                    return resolve(*args, **kwargs)
                def tracked_parameters(value):
                    trace.append(('parameters', deepcopy(value)))
                    return parameters(value)
                with patch.object(owner.types, 'resolve', side_effect=tracked_resolve), patch.object(
                        owner, 'parameters', side_effect=tracked_parameters):
                    _, error = outcome(call)
                snapshot = {name: (id(item.typ), item.names, item.external, item.consumed)
                            for name, item in env.items()}
                return error, owner.serial, deepcopy(current_ops), snapshot, trace
            for changed, values, declarations in choices:
                for serial in serials:
                    restore(); owner.serial = serial
                    reference_ops = list(ops)
                    expected = observed(lambda: reference(owner, changed, values, declarations,
                        env, reference_ops, consume, outputs, record_field), reference_ops)
                    restore(); owner.serial = serial
                    native_ops = list(ops)
                    with patch('hepta.hia_record_operations_native.selected_record_operations', return_value=case.native):
                        native = observed(lambda: selected(owner, changed, values, declarations,
                            env, native_ops, consume, outputs, record_field), native_ops)
                    case.assertEqual(native, expected, (changed, serial))
                    case.assertEqual(owner.serial, serial)
                    case.assertEqual(native_ops, ops)
                    observations.append((changed['op'], expected[0], expected[3], expected[4]))
            restore(); owner.serial = initial_serial
            return reference(owner, ins, actual, declared, env, ops, consume, outputs, record_field)
        with patch.object(composite._Elaborator, 'lower_record_operation', compare):
            _, original_error = outcome(lambda: verify_core(document))
        self.assertTrue(observations, 'fixture must reach an actual record operation')
        return observations, original_error

    def test_actual_machine_allocator_failures_moves_and_cleanup(self):
        from hepta.hia_program_native import emit_program_machine, compile_program_machine
        cc = shutil.which('cc'); self.assertIsNotNone(cc)
        driver = r'''
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
void *__real_calloc(size_t,size_t); void __real_free(void *);
static void *live[16]; static size_t allocations,frees,refusals,attempt,fail_at;
void *__wrap_calloc(size_t n,size_t w){
  attempt++;if(fail_at && attempt==fail_at){refusals++;return NULL;}
  void *p=__real_calloc(n,w);if(p){for(size_t i=0;i<16;i++)if(!live[i]){live[i]=p;allocations++;return p;}exit(80);}return p;
}
void __wrap_free(void *p){if(p){size_t i;for(i=0;i<16 && live[i]!=p;i++);if(i==16)exit(81);live[i]=NULL;frees++;}__real_free(p);}
size_t roundtrip(size_t,uint8_t);
int main(void){
  if(roundtrip(7,0)!=31 || roundtrip(7,1)!=33 || roundtrip(0,0)!=17)return 82;
  attempt=0;fail_at=1;if(roundtrip(7,0)!=250)return 83;
  attempt=0;fail_at=2;if(roundtrip(7,0)!=24)return 84;
  for(size_t i=0;i<16;i++)if(live[i])return 85;
  printf("%zu %zu %zu\n",allocations,frees,refusals);
  return allocations!=4 || frees!=4 || refusals!=2;
}
'''
        with self.selected(), patch.object(composite._Elaborator, '_reference_record_transition',
                side_effect=AssertionError('host transition called')):
            checked = verify_core(partials.roundtrip_program())
        obj = self.folder / 'transition-effects.o'
        compile_program_machine(emit_program_machine(checked), program=checked, output=obj, kind='object', linker=cc)
        source, executable = self.folder / 'transition-effects.c', self.folder / 'transition-effects'
        source.write_text(driver)
        built = subprocess.run([cc, '-std=c11', '-O2', str(source), str(obj),
            '-Wl,--wrap=calloc', '-Wl,--wrap=free', '-o', str(executable)], capture_output=True, timeout=30)
        self.assertEqual(built.returncode, 0, built.stdout + built.stderr)
        ran = subprocess.run([str(executable)], capture_output=True, timeout=30)

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
KEY, DIGEST, STARTED = b'a' * 64, b'd' * 64, b'17'
RESPONSE = b'{"result":{"answer":7},"status":"completed"}'
CAPACITY = 2048


@contextmanager
def interrupt_opcode(code, opname, name):
    """Inject once at an actual interpreter boundary, with a positive witness."""
    offsets = {item.offset for item in dis.get_instructions(code)
               if item.opname == opname and item.argval == name}
    assert len(offsets) == 1, (opname, name, offsets)
    observations = []
    def trace(frame, event, arg):
        if frame.f_code is code:
            frame.f_trace_opcodes = True
            if event == 'opcode' and frame.f_lasti in offsets and not observations:
                observations.append({'opcode': opname, 'name': name, 'offset': frame.f_lasti})
                raise KeyboardInterrupt('actual request journal interpreter handoff')
        return trace
    previous, frames, frame = sys.gettrace(), [], sys._getframe()
    while frame is not None:
        frames.append((frame, frame.f_trace_opcodes))
        frame.f_trace_opcodes = True
        frame = frame.f_back
    try:
        sys.settrace(trace)
        yield observations
    finally:
        sys.settrace(previous)
        for frame, flag in frames:
            frame.f_trace_opcodes = flag
        assert len(observations) == 1, 'requested interpreter interruption did not occur'


def packet(event, sequence=0, values=(), *, effect_token=0, payload=b'', identity=(11, 17), connection=(31, 37)):
    words = [REQUEST_MAGIC, event, sequence, effect_token, *values]
    words += [0] * (12 - len(words))
    return struct.pack('<16Q', *words, *identity, *connection) + payload


def initial(tool=b'hia_artifact', key=b'key'):
    return packet(0, values=(len(tool), len(STARTED), 1, len(key), 64),
                  payload=tool + DIGEST + STARTED + key + KEY)


def row(sequence, tool, state=b'running', response=None):
    raw = b'' if response is None else response
    return packet(2, sequence, (1, len(state), len(tool), len(STARTED), int(response is not None),
                  len(raw), 64, 64), payload=KEY + DIGEST + tool + state + STARTED + raw)


def header(result):
    count, output, _ = result
    assert 128 <= count <= CAPACITY + OUTPUT_PREFIX, count
    h = struct.unpack('<16Q', output[:128])
    assert h[0] == RESULT_MAGIC, h
    return h


class VM:
    def __init__(self):
        from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import assemble_program
        self.program = assemble_program(SOURCE.read_bytes())
        self.entry = next(f for f in self.program.as_dict()['functions'] if f['name'] == 'f0')
        self.state = bytearray(STATE_PREFIX + CAPACITY)

    def call(self, raw):
        from hepta.hia_program_runtime import _Machine, _Owner, _View
        objects = [_Owner(-1, bytearray(raw)), _Owner(-2, bytearray(OUTPUT_PREFIX + CAPACITY)),
                   _Owner(-3, self.state)]
        machine = _Machine(self.program, 100000000, 16 << 20, None, 128)
        count = machine.invoke(self.entry, [_View(objects[0], False), _View(objects[1], True),
                                           _View(objects[2], True)])[0]
        return count, bytes(objects[1].data[:count]), bytes(self.state)


class Machine:
    def __init__(self, image):
        self.image = image
        self.size = STATE_PREFIX + CAPACITY
        self.state = ctypes.create_string_buffer(self.size + 16)
        ctypes.memset(ctypes.addressof(self.state) + self.size, 0xb7, 16)

    def call(self, raw):
        source = ctypes.create_string_buffer(raw, len(raw))
        size = OUTPUT_PREFIX + CAPACITY
        output = ctypes.create_string_buffer(size + 16)
        ctypes.memset(ctypes.addressof(output) + size, 0xa5, 16)
        count = self.image._entry(source, len(raw), output, size, self.state, self.size)
        assert source.raw == raw
        assert output.raw[size:] == b'\xa5' * 16
        assert self.state.raw[self.size:] == b'\xb7' * 16
        return count, output.raw[:count], self.state.raw[:self.size]


def witnesses(engine, kind='normal'):
    tool = b'hia_adopt' if kind in ('atomic', 'rollback') else b'hia_artifact'
    observations, sequence, pending = [], 0, 0
    def send(raw, action=None, phase=None):
        nonlocal sequence, pending
        answer = engine.call(raw); h = header(answer)
        assert h[1] == 0, h
        if action is not None: assert h[2] == action, h
        if phase is not None: assert h[4] == phase, h
        sequence, pending = h[3], h[8]
        observations.append((raw, answer))
        return h
    def call(event, values=(), *, payload=b'', token=0, action=None, phase=None):
        return send(packet(event, sequence, values, payload=payload, effect_token=token), action, phase)
    send(initial(tool), 1, 1)
    call(1, (1,), action=2, phase=2)
    if kind == 'replay':
        send(row(sequence, tool, b'completed', RESPONSE), 8, 11)
        call(90, action=8, phase=11)
        call(9, (1,), token=pending, action=5, phase=5)
        call(4, (1,), action=0, phase=8)
        return observations
    call(2, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0), action=3, phase=3)
    call(3, (1,), action=2, phase=4)
    send(row(sequence, tool), 5, 5)
    call(4, (1,), action=0, phase=6)
    if kind in ('atomic', 'rollback'):
        call(5, action=1, phase=1)
        call(1, (1,), action=2, phase=2)
        send(row(sequence, tool), 7, 7)
    else:
        call(5, action=7, phase=7)
    call(90, action=7, phase=7)
    if kind == 'rollback':
        call(7, (1,), token=pending, action=6, phase=10)
        raw = packet(91)
        answer = engine.call(raw)
        magic, status, granted, epoch = struct.unpack('<4Q', answer[1])
        assert (magic, status, granted) == (CLEANUP_MAGIC, 0, 1) and epoch > 0
        observations.append((raw, answer))
        call(8, (1,), action=0, phase=6)
    else:
        call(12, (len(RESPONSE), 1), payload=RESPONSE, token=pending, action=0, phase=12)
    call(6, (len(RESPONSE), 1), payload=RESPONSE, action=4 if kind == 'atomic' else 1)
    if kind != 'atomic':
        call(1, (1,), action=2, phase=2)
        send(row(sequence, tool), 4, 3)
    call(3, (1,), action=2, phase=4)
    send(row(sequence, tool, b'completed', RESPONSE), 5, 5)
    call(4, (1,), action=0, phase=8)
    before = observations[-1][1][2]
    call(6, (len(RESPONSE), 1), payload=RESPONSE, action=0, phase=8)
    assert observations[-1][1][2] == before
    return observations

                store = AgentStore(directory); journal = store.request_journal

                    execute, attempts = journal._execute, []
                    def interrupt(sql, parameters=()):
                        if sql == 'ROLLBACK':
                            attempts.append(sql)
                            if position == 'before': raise KeyboardInterrupt('before actual rollback')
                        cursor = execute(sql, parameters)
                        if sql == 'ROLLBACK' and position == 'after':
                            raise KeyboardInterrupt('after actual rollback before acknowledgement')

        from hepta.hia_agent_store import AgentStore
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory, self.selected():
            store = AgentStore(directory); journal = store.request_journal
            held, release, attempted = threading.Event(), threading.Event(), threading.Event()
            try:
                ticket = journal.admit('hia_adopt', DIGEST.decode(), 'ordinary-writer', lambda *args: None)
                def invoke(connection):
                    connection.execute('INSERT INTO slots VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',
                        ('ordinary-writer', 'context', '1', '1', 'a' * 64))
                    held.set()
                    if not release.wait(5): raise TimeoutError('atomic control not released')
                    return {'status': 'completed'}
                def ordinary():
                    attempted.set()
                    store.db.execute('INSERT INTO costs(context_id,tool,request_id,wall_ns,status,details) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                        (None, 'ordinary', 'outside', '1', 'completed', '{}'))
                with ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as pool:
                    first = pool.submit(ticket.atomic, invoke, lambda result: result)
                    self.assertTrue(held.wait(5))
                    second = pool.submit(ordinary)
                    self.assertTrue(attempted.wait(5))
                    try:
                        with self.assertRaises(FutureTimeout): second.result(timeout=0.1)
                        with sqlite3.connect(store.database) as observer:
                            self.assertEqual(observer.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM main.slots').fetchone()[0], 0)
                            self.assertEqual(observer.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM main.costs').fetchone()[0], 0)
                            self.assertEqual(observer.execute('SELECT state FROM main.requests').fetchone()[0], 'running')
                    finally: release.set()
                    first.result(timeout=5); second.result(timeout=5)

                self.assertEqual(store.db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM main.costs').fetchone()[0], 1)

"""Caller-gate source/admission controls; no simulated run is called native.

The frozen four Agent modules are loaded, never executed here. Controlled cold
admission rows exercise the outer no-output gate; the real builder and all 48
Agent methods are executed only by qualify_hia_service_artifacts's public CLI.
"""
from contextlib import contextmanager, redirect_stderr

@contextmanager
def controlled_admission():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hia-artifacts-caller-admission-') as folder:
        directory = Path(folder)
        compiler = directory / 'compiler'; compiler.write_bytes(b'controlled, not executable')
        digest = sha256(compiler.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        sources = {name: sha256((gate.ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                   for name in (*builder.REQUIRED_SOURCE_NAMES, *gate.SELF_SOURCES, *gate.ORIGINAL_FILES)}
        nested = directory / 'nested.json'
        nested.write_bytes(gate._wire({'source_manifest': sources,
            'generations': [{'produced_image': str(compiler), 'produced_sha256': digest} for _ in range(3)]}))
        cold = directory / 'cold.json'
        outer = {'nested_report': str(nested), 'nested_report_sha256': sha256(nested.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                 'qualification_wall_limit_seconds': 180, 'cleanup_wall_limit_seconds': 3,
                 'generation_sha256': [digest] * 3}
        cold.write_bytes(gate._wire(outer))
        with patch.object(builder, 'admit_cold_build', return_value=sources), patch.object(gate, '_snapshot', return_value=sources):
            yield SimpleNamespace(directory=directory, compiler=compiler, cold=cold, outer=outer,
                                  nested=nested, sources=sources, output=directory / 'output')

"""Caller-gate source/admission controls; no simulated run is called native.

The frozen four Agent modules are loaded, never executed here. Controlled cold
admission rows exercise the outer no-output gate; the real builder and all 48
Agent methods are executed only by qualify_hia_service_evaluation's public CLI.
"""
from contextlib import contextmanager, redirect_stderr
from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
import io

@contextmanager
def controlled_admission():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hia-evaluation-caller-admission-') as folder:
        directory = Path(folder)
        compiler = directory / 'compiler'; compiler.write_bytes(b'controlled, not executable')
        digest = sha256(compiler.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        sources = {name: sha256((gate.ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                   for name in (*builder.REQUIRED_SOURCE_NAMES, *gate.SELF_SOURCES, *gate.ORIGINAL_FILES)}
        nested = directory / 'nested.json'
        nested.write_bytes(gate._wire({'source_manifest': sources,
            'generations': [{'produced_image': str(compiler), 'produced_sha256': digest} for _ in range(3)]}))
        cold = directory / 'cold.json'
        outer = {'nested_report': str(nested), 'nested_report_sha256': sha256(nested.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                 'qualification_wall_limit_seconds': 180, 'cleanup_wall_limit_seconds': 3,
                 'generation_sha256': [digest] * 3}
        cold.write_bytes(gate._wire(outer))
        with patch.object(builder, 'admit_cold_build', return_value=sources), patch.object(gate, '_snapshot', return_value=sources):
            yield SimpleNamespace(directory=directory, compiler=compiler, cold=cold, outer=outer,
                                  nested=nested, sources=sources, output=directory / 'output')

The frozen four Agent modules are loaded, never executed here. Controlled cold
admission rows exercise the outer no-output gate; the real builder and all 48
Agent methods are executed only by qualify_hia_service_requests's public CLI.
"""
from contextlib import contextmanager, redirect_stderr

@contextmanager
def controlled_admission():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hia-requests-caller-admission-') as folder:
        directory = Path(folder)
        compiler = directory / 'compiler'; compiler.write_bytes(b'controlled, not executable')
        digest = sha256(compiler.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        sources = {name: sha256((gate.ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                   for name in (*builder.REQUIRED_SOURCE_NAMES, *gate.SELF_SOURCES, *gate.ORIGINAL_FILES)}
        nested = directory / 'nested.json'
        nested.write_bytes(gate._wire({'source_manifest': sources,
            'generations': [{'produced_image': str(compiler), 'produced_sha256': digest} for _ in range(3)]}))
        cold = directory / 'cold.json'
        outer = {'nested_report': str(nested), 'nested_report_sha256': sha256(nested.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                 'qualification_wall_limit_seconds': 180, 'cleanup_wall_limit_seconds': 3,
                 'generation_sha256': [digest] * 3}
        cold.write_bytes(gate._wire(outer))
        with patch.object(builder, 'admit_cold_build', return_value=sources), patch.object(gate, '_snapshot', return_value=sources):
            yield SimpleNamespace(directory=directory, compiler=compiler, cold=cold, outer=outer,
                                  nested=nested, sources=sources, output=directory / 'output')

            def entry(source, size, output, capacity, work, extent):

                answer = actual_entry(source, size, output, capacity, work, extent)

                          if item.opname == 'STORE_FAST' and item.argval == 'observed')
            def trace(pyframe, event, arg):

                    pyframe.f_trace_opcodes = True
                    if event == 'opcode' and pyframe.f_lasti == offset:
                        injected.append(offset); raise fault
                return trace
            try:

                    prior = sys.gettrace(); arming = sys._getframe()
                    old_trace, old_opcodes = arming.f_trace, arming.f_trace_opcodes
                    arming.f_trace = trace; arming.f_trace_opcodes = True
                    sys.settrace(trace)

                            frame.service(issued)

                else:

                        frame.service(issued)

                            frame.step()

                self.assertEqual(len(calls), 0 if boundary == 'claim' else 1)
                self.assertTrue(frame._uncertain)

                self.assertEqual(len(calls), 0 if boundary == 'claim' else 1)
                rows.append({'boundary': boundary, 'positive_injections': injected, 'calls': len(calls),

                struct.pack_into('<6Q', state, 0, command, nonce, sequence,
                                 mode if command == 0 else op if command == 2 else flag, error, self.image.runtime_profile)
                raw = self.image.table
                src = ctypes.create_string_buffer(raw + b'\xa5' * 16, len(raw) + 16)
                out = ctypes.create_string_buffer(bytes(output) + b'\xb7' * 16, len(output) + 16)
                work = ctypes.create_string_buffer(bytes(state) + b'\xc9' * 16, len(state) + 16)
                actual = self.image._entry(src, len(raw), out, len(output), work, len(state))
                owners = [_Owner(-1, bytearray(raw)), _Owner(-2, bytearray(output)), _Owner(-3, bytearray(state))]
                expected = _Machine(checked, 10000000, 16 << 20, None, 128).invoke(function,
                    [_View(owners[0], False), _View(owners[1], True), _View(owners[2], True)])[0]

                return actual
            self.assertEqual(call(0), 1)

                status = call(1)

def _json_bytes(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True) + '\n').encode('ascii')


def _write(path, raw):
    with path.open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(raw)
        stream.flush()


def _selection():
    cold, development = os.environ.get(COLD_REPORT), os.environ.get(DEVELOPMENT_COMPILER)
    if cold and development:
        raise ValueError('cold and development source-admission inputs are mutually exclusive')
    if not cold and not development:
        raise unittest.SkipTest('explicit fresh cold report or retained development compiler required')
    return cold, development

def init_wire(names, nonce=17, declared_count=None):
    n = len(names) if declared_count is None else declared_count
    raw = bytearray(struct.pack('<4Q', 0, nonce, n, len(names)-n))
    for i, name in enumerate(names):
        value = name.encode('utf-8', 'surrogatepass')
        raw += struct.pack('<2Q', i, len(value)) + value
    return bytes(raw)


def raw_call(native, wire, state, *, output_size=512, state_size=None):
    source = ctypes.create_string_buffer(wire+b'\x33'*16, len(wire)+16)
    output = ctypes.create_string_buffer(b'\x5a'*(output_size+16), output_size+16)
    before = source.raw
    code = native._entry(source, len(wire), output, output_size, state,
                         len(state) if state_size is None else state_size)
    assert source.raw == before
    assert output.raw[output_size:] == b'\x5a'*16
    return code, output.raw[:output_size]


def sealed_state(raw):
    """Independent test-only checksum, never runtime admission authority."""
    value = bytearray(raw)
    extent = struct.unpack_from('<Q', value, 64)[0]
    h = 14695981039346656037
    for i, b in enumerate(value[:extent]):
        if not 120 <= i < 128:
            h = ((h ^ b) * 1099511628211) & ((1 << 64)-1)
    struct.pack_into('<Q', value, 120, h)
    return bytes(value)


def vm_buffers(wires, state_size=1688, output_size=128):
    import ast
    from tools.generate_hia_source_admission import source_program
    from tools.hia_selfhost_bulk import Body
    from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import assemble_program
    from hepta.hia_program import execute_program
    body = Body(0)
    owners, views = [], []
    for size in (output_size, state_size):
        owner = body.value('buffer', 'buffer.new', [body.const('usize', size)])
        owners.append(owner)
        views.append(body.value('mutbuf', 'borrow.mut', [owner]))
    results = []
    for wire in wires:
        owner = body.value('buffer', 'buffer.new', [body.const('usize', len(wire))])
        view = body.value('mutbuf', 'borrow.mut', [owner])
        for i, value in enumerate(wire):
            if value:
                body.effect('buffer.store', [view, body.const('usize', i), body.const('u8', value)])
        body.effect('loan.end', [view])
        read = body.value('readbuf', 'borrow.read', [owner])
        results.append(body.value('u32', 'call', [read, *views], {'function': 'f0'}))
        body.effect('loan.end', [read]); body.effect('owner.drop', [owner])
    observed = []
    names = {node.name: 'f'+str(i) for i, node in enumerate(ast.parse(source_program()).body)}
    for view, size in zip(views, (output_size, state_size)):
        # Losslessly pack the complete buffers into u64 returns so the original
        # 256-item assembly list limit remains unchanged.
        assert size % 8 == 0
        observed.extend(body.value('u64', 'call', [view, body.const('u64', i)],
                                   {'function': names['get']}) for i in range(0, size, 8))
    for view in views: body.effect('loan.end', [view])
    for owner in owners: body.effect('owner.drop', [owner])
    source = ('hia-asm.v1 hepta.hia.program.v8 source_admission_vm\n'
              'fn observe() -> ('+','.join(['u32']*len(results)+['u64']*len(observed))+') '
              'effects(alloc,read,write,trap) entry(b0)\nblock b0()\n'+body.text()
              +'  ret('+','.join([*results, *observed])+')\nend\n'
              +SOURCE.read_text().split('\n', 1)[1])
    with patch.dict(os.environ, {key: '' for key in os.environ if key.startswith('HEPTA_HIA_')}):
        actual = execute_program(assemble_program(source), 'observe', [], max_steps=2_000_000)
    if actual['status'] != 'returned':
        raise AssertionError(actual)
    raw = b''.join(struct.pack('<Q', value) for value in actual['values'][len(wires):])
    return actual['values'][:len(wires)], raw, actual['steps']

        vectors += [rng.randbytes(n) for n in (1, 54, 55, 56, 57, 63, 64, 65, 119, 120, 127, 128, 129, 255, 256)]

            for i, name in enumerate(names): (root/name).write_bytes(bytes([i]))
            (root/'hepta'/'dynamic.py').write_bytes(b'dynamic')
            declared = tuple(reversed(names)) + ('z', 'a', 'hepta/dynamic.py')
            result = self.native.create().run(root, declared)

                        for name in sorted(set(declared))}

            (root/'hepta'/'dynamic.py').unlink()

            for invalid in ('', 'a\x00b'):
                owner = self.native.create()
                with self.assertRaises((IsADirectoryError, ValueError)):
                    owner.run(root, (invalid,))
                self.assertFalse(owner.complete)
                self.assertEqual(owner.failure_receipt[0], 4)

    def test_stale_foreign_nonce_outcomes_and_mutated_state_refuse_without_write(self):
        state = ctypes.create_string_buffer(2048)
        self.assertEqual(raw_call(self.native, init_wire(['a']), state)[0], 0)
        self.assertEqual(raw_call(self.native, adapter.packet(1, 17, 0), state)[0], 0)
        pending = state.raw
        wires = [adapter.packet(1, 17, 0), adapter.packet(1, 17, 1),
                 adapter.packet(2, 18, 1, b'abc'), adapter.packet(2, 17, 0, b'abc'),
                 struct.pack('<4Q', 2, 17, 1, 4)+b'abc', struct.pack('<3Q', 8, 17, 1)]
        for wire in wires:
            with self.subTest(wire=wire.hex()):
                self.assertEqual(raw_call(self.native, wire, state)[0], 16)
                self.assertEqual(state.raw, pending)
        for offset in (0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 72, 80, 120, 1536, 1648):
            state = ctypes.create_string_buffer(pending, len(pending))
            state[offset] = bytes([state.raw[offset] ^ 1])
            before = state.raw
            self.assertEqual(raw_call(self.native, adapter.packet(2, 17, 1, b'abc'), state)[0], 16)
            self.assertEqual(state.raw, before)
        state = ctypes.create_string_buffer(pending, len(pending))
        self.assertEqual(raw_call(self.native, adapter.packet(2, 17, 1, b'abc'), state)[0], 0)
        done = state.raw
        self.assertEqual(raw_call(self.native, adapter.packet(2, 17, 1, b'abc'), state)[0], 16)
        self.assertEqual(state.raw, done)

    def test_every_transition_output_and_state_equal_original_HIA_machine(self):
        original = _fixture().reference
        optimized = image()
        rng = random.Random(0x821512)
        transitions = 0
        for trial in range(16):
            names = [rng.choice(('z', 'a', 'é', '中', '😀', '\udcff'))+str(rng.randrange(12))
                     for _ in range(trial+1)]
            payloads = {name: rng.randbytes(rng.randrange(1537)) for name in names}
            states = [ctypes.create_string_buffer(8192), ctypes.create_string_buffer(8192)]
            nonce = 0x765000+trial
            def compare(wire):
                nonlocal transitions
                left = raw_call(original, wire, states[0], output_size=2048)
                right = raw_call(optimized, wire, states[1], output_size=2048)
                self.assertEqual(right, left)
                self.assertEqual(states[1].raw, states[0].raw)
                transitions += 1
                return struct.unpack_from('<6Q', right[1]), right[1]
            reply, _ = compare(init_wire(names, nonce=nonce, declared_count=len(names)//2))
            self.assertEqual(reply[0:2], (0, 0)); sequence=0
            while True:
                reply, raw = compare(adapter.packet(1, nonce, sequence))
                if reply[1] == 2:
                    actual={}

                    self.assertEqual(actual, {n:sha256(v).hexdigest() for n,v in payloads.items()})
                    break

                compare(adapter.packet(2, nonce, sequence, payloads[names[reply[4]]]))

            'original_image_sha256':original.image_sha256,'optimized_image_sha256':optimized.image_sha256,

def _freshness_controls(folder, image):
    from tools import hia_selfhost_contract as contract
    original = contract.file_digests
    real_open, real_sha = io.open, sha256
    evidence = folder / 'freshness'
    evidence.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    control_root = evidence / 'source'
    control_root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    baseline = original(ROOT)
    for name, expected in baseline.items():
        raw = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
        if real_sha(raw).hexdigest() != expected:
            raise AssertionError('source changed while copying freshness control inputs')
        path = control_root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(raw)
    compilation = _fixture().compilation
    report = {'scope': _fixture().scope + '_ORIGINAL_ELEVEN_FRESHNESS_CONTROLS',
              'python': sys.version, 'image_sha256': compilation['image_sha256'],
              'source_sha256': compilation['source_sha256'], 'controls': [],
              'original_control_report': 'retained prototype COMPARISON.json; immutable archive provenance documented',
              'original_control_report_sha256': 'b262f49e6bd309bf9cea2ffff8383705bb6f242420389880909dea1cad26c3f9',
              'native_stage_events_are_boundary_observations': True,
              'hex_fault_is_after_HIA_digest_ACK_boundary_not_internal_hex_failure': True,
              'current_source_cold': _fixture().cold is not None,
              'whole_cold': False, 'full': False, 'default': False, 'live': False, 'deletion': False,
              'original_limits_changed': False}
    before = original(control_root)
    expected_order = list(before)
    assert before == baseline
    count = len(before)
    assert count >= 3 and 'tests/__init__.py' in before
    def save():
        (evidence/'RESULT.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
    save()

    def observe(native=False, *, read_error=None, close_error=None, hash_error=None, hex_error=None):
        events=[]; current=[None]; owner = image.create() if native else None
        class Stream:
            def __init__(self, file, name): self.file,self.name=file,name
            def __enter__(self): events.append(['enter',self.name]);self.file.__enter__();return self
            def read(self,*a,**kw):
                events.append(['read',self.name])
                if self.name==read_error: raise OSError(5,'injected read failure',self.name)
                return self.file.read(*a,**kw)
            def __exit__(self,*args):
                events.append(['close',self.name]);r=self.file.__exit__(*args)
                if self.name==close_error: raise OSError(5,'injected close failure',self.name)
                return r
        def opener(file,*args,**kwargs):
            name=Path(file).relative_to(control_root).as_posix()
            current[0]=name;events.append(['open',name])
            return Stream(real_open(file,*args,**kwargs),name)
        class Hash:
            def __init__(self,value,name):self.value,self.name=value,name
            def hexdigest(self):
                events.append(['hexdigest',self.name])
                if self.name==hex_error: raise ValueError('injected hexdigest failure')
                return self.value.hexdigest()
        def sha(raw):
            if native: raise AssertionError('selected native owner called original Python file hash')
            name=current[0];events.append(['sha256',name])
            if name==hash_error:raise ValueError('injected hash failure')
            return Hash(real_sha(raw),name)
        if native:
            actual_invoke = owner._invoke
            def invoke(wire):
                if int.from_bytes(wire[:8], 'little') == 2:
                    name = current[0]
                    events.append(['sha256', name])
                    if name == hash_error: raise ValueError('injected hash failure')
                    receipt = actual_invoke(wire)
                    events.append(['hexdigest', name])
                    if name == hex_error: raise ValueError('injected hexdigest failure')
                    return receipt
                return actual_invoke(wire)
            owner._invoke = invoke
        result=None;error=None; started=time.perf_counter()
        try:
            with patch.object(io,'open',opener), patch.object(contract,'sha256',sha):
                result = owner.run(control_root, contract.SOURCE_FILES) if native else original(control_root)
        except BaseException as exc:
            error={'class':type(exc).__qualname__,'args':repr(exc.args),
                   'errno':getattr(exc,'errno',None),'filename':getattr(exc,'filename',None),
                   'cause':None if exc.__cause__ is None else type(exc.__cause__).__qualname__,
                   'context':None if exc.__context__ is None else type(exc.__context__).__qualname__}
        row={'events':events,'result_items':None if result is None else list(result.items()),'error':error}
        custody = None
        if native:
            custody = owner.snapshot(); state=custody.pop('state')
            custody['state_sha256']=real_sha(state).hexdigest()
            if error:
                old=(owner.calls,owner.reads,state)
                try:owner.run(control_root,contract.SOURCE_FILES)
                except RuntimeError:pass
                else:raise AssertionError('failed single-use owner replayed')
                assert (owner.calls,owner.reads,owner.state.raw)==old
                assert not owner.complete
        return row, {'wall_seconds': time.perf_counter()-started, 'custody': custody}

    def paired(name, **kwargs):
        original_row,original_info=observe(**kwargs)
        native_row,native_info=observe(True,**kwargs)
        row={'name':name,'original':original_row,'native':native_row,
             'original_info':original_info,'native_info':native_info,'equal':original_row==native_row}
        report['controls'].append(row);save()
        assert original_row==native_row,name
        return original_row

    started=time.perf_counter()
    try:
        r=paired('all_current_sources_original_read_close_hash_order')
        assert r['error'] is None and len(r['events'])==6*count
        assert r['events']==[[event,name] for name in expected_order
                            for event in ('open','enter','read','close','sha256','hexdigest')]
        target=control_root/expected_order[0];raw=target.read_bytes();old=target.stat()
        try:
            target.write_bytes(raw+b'\n# development freshness witness\n')
            os.utime(target,ns=(old.st_atime_ns,old.st_mtime_ns))
            r=paired('changed_bytes_with_original_mtime')
            changed=dict(r['result_items'])
            assert changed[expected_order[0]]!=before[expected_order[0]]
            assert {n for n in changed if changed[n]!=before[n]}=={expected_order[0]}
        finally:
            target.write_bytes(raw);os.utime(target,ns=(old.st_atime_ns,old.st_mtime_ns))
        dynamic=control_root/'hepta'/'zz_development_fresh_witness.py'
        try:
            dynamic.write_bytes(b'# new fresh source input\n')
            r=paired('new_dynamic_python_file_observed')
            assert len(r['result_items'])==count+1 and 'hepta/zz_development_fresh_witness.py' in dict(r['result_items'])
        finally:dynamic.unlink()
        r=paired('removed_dynamic_python_file_not_cached');assert dict(r['result_items'])==before
        first,second=expected_order[:2];moved=[]
        try:
            for i,name in enumerate((first,second)):
                source=control_root/name;backup=evidence/f'native-control-original-missing-{i}'
                source.rename(backup);moved.append((source,backup))
            r=paired('two_missing_inputs_first_sorted_error')
            assert r['error']['class']=='FileNotFoundError' and r['events']==[['open',first]]
        finally:
            for source,backup in reversed(moved):backup.rename(source)
        name='tests/__init__.py';source=control_root/name;backup=evidence/'native-control-original-directory-input'
        source.rename(backup);source.mkdir()
        try:
            r=paired('regular_input_replaced_with_directory')
            assert r['error']['class']=='IsADirectoryError' and r['events'][-1]==['open',name]
        finally:source.rmdir();backup.rename(source)
        for label,key in [('read_failure_prefix','read_error'),('close_failure_prefix','close_error'),
                          ('hash_failure_prefix','hash_error'),('hexdigest_failure_prefix','hex_error')]:
            r=paired(label,**{key:second});assert r['error'] is not None
            assert not any(event==['open',expected_order[2]] for event in r['events'])
        source=control_root/second;backup=evidence/'native-control-original-later-missing';source.rename(backup)
        try:
            r=paired('earlier_hash_failure_precedes_later_missing_read',hash_error=first)
            assert r['error']['class']=='ValueError' and ['open',second] not in r['events']
        finally:backup.rename(source)
        assert original(control_root)==before and original(ROOT)==before
        report.update(status='PASS', source_before_after_equal=True, control_source_restored=True)
    except BaseException:
        report.update(status='FAIL', traceback=traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        report['wall_seconds']=time.perf_counter()-started
        save()
        summary={k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='controls'}
        summary['controls']=[{'name':r['name'],'equal':r['equal'],
            'original_error':r['original']['error'], 'native_info':r['native_info']} for r in report['controls']]
        summary['raw_report_bytes']=(evidence/'RESULT.json').stat().st_size
        summary['raw_report_sha256']=real_sha((evidence/'RESULT.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        (evidence/'SUMMARY.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
        print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
    if report['status'] != 'PASS':
        raise AssertionError(report['traceback'])
    assert len(report['controls']) == 11
    return summary

    @classmethod

    def _compile_transport(self, *, mutate=None, collision=False):
        """Inject at the fixed compiler transport using actual retained bytes.

        This does not re-run a compiler or establish a new cold result. It
        checks this builder's refusal/publication boundaries independently.

            self.assertEqual(compiler.read_bytes(), fixture.snapshots[fixture.compiler])
            self.assertEqual(source, fixture.snapshots[SOURCE])
            image_path = output / (label + '.image.bin')
            image_path.write_bytes(image_bytes)
            receipt = dict(original, case=label, produced_image=str(image_path))
            if mutate:
                mutate(receipt)
            (output / (label + '.receipt.json')).write_bytes(_json_bytes(receipt))
            if collision:
                (output / 'development-manifest.json').write_bytes(b'previous publication')
            return image_path, receipt

            'wrong_image_path': lambda value: value.update(produced_image='elsewhere.image.bin'),
        }

def reference_helper_cache(self, typ, operation, *, require_native=False):
    key = (typ.key, operation)
    if key in self.helper_names:
        return self.helper_names[key]
    from hepta.hia_task_helpers_native import selected_task_helpers
    selected = selected_task_helpers()
    if selected is None:
        if require_native:
            _reject("selected native function requires native task helper generation", "E_HIA_TYPE")
        return self._reference_helper(typ, operation)
    step = self.check_task(typ)
    result = selected.generate(typ, step, operation, self.serial,
        self.functions[typ.poll]["effects"], self.functions[typ.cancel]["effects"])
    self.serial = result.serial
    if result.name is not None:
        self.helper_names[key] = result.name
    result.admit()
    self.helpers.append(result.helper)
    return result.name


def reference_ast(function):
    body = ast.parse(textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(function))).body[0].body
    # The independent copy lives in tests, so its import is absolute. No
    # executable statement or branch differs from the captured old wrapper.
    for node in ast.walk(ast.Module(body=body, type_ignores=[])):
        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == 'hepta.hia_task_helpers_native':
            node.module, node.level = 'hia_task_helpers_native', 1
    from tests.hia_reference_ast import reference_ast_dump
    return sha256(reference_ast_dump(ast.Module(body=body, type_ignores=[])).encode()).hexdigest()


def wire(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False,
                      allow_nan=False).encode()


def opaque_owner():
    nonce = object()
    typ = SimpleNamespace(key=_NativeTypeIdentity(nonce, 1))
    owner = SimpleNamespace(helper_names={}, helpers=[], serial=0, native_types=None)
    return owner, typ


def observed(owner, action):
    try:
        value, error = action(), None
    except HIAProgramRejected as exc:
        value, error = None, (type(exc).__name__, exc.code, str(exc))
    except KeyError as exc:
        value, error = None, (type(exc).__name__, exc.args)
    names = tuple((key.identifier, operation, name) for (key, operation), name in owner.helper_names.items())
    observations = owner.native_types.observations if hasattr(owner.native_types, 'observations') else None
    return value, error, owner.serial, names, deepcopy(owner.helpers), observations

        image = object.__new__(NativeTaskHelperCache)
        def entry(source, size, output, capacity, workspace, workspace_size):
            if mutate:
                ctypes.memmove(source, b'x', 1)
            if type(data) is int:

            ctypes.memmove(output, data, len(data))
            return len(data)
        image._entry = entry
        return image

    def frame(self, *, error=0, request=1, sequence=1, reserved=0, value=None):
        if value is None:

            extent = self.native._entry(source, len(data), output, OUTPUT_BYTES, workspace, WORKSPACE_BYTES)

            self.assertEqual(ctypes.string_at(ctypes.addressof(workspace) + WORKSPACE_BYTES, 32), b'\xb9' * 32)

    def frame(self, context, *, request=0, error=0, final=None, query=None, ops=None, values=None, flags=None):
        if values is None:
            values = [] if request in (1, 2, 3) or error or context.operation == 'task.close' or context.phase == 2 else [['out', 0, ['token'], False, False]]
        if query is None and request:
            query = ({'type': 0} if request == 1 else {'type': 'u8'} if request == 2 else
                     {} if request == 3 else {'type': 0, 'operation': context.operation[5:]})
        raw = wire({'ops': [] if ops is None else ops,
                    'consumed': [False] if flags is None else flags, 'values': values, 'query': query})
        return struct.pack('<8Q', MAGIC, error, context.serial if final is None else final,
                           request, len(raw), 0, 0, 0) + raw

    def image(self, data, *, mutate=False):
        image = object.__new__(NativeTaskOperations)
        def entry(source, size, output, capacity, workspace, workspace_size):
            if mutate:
                ctypes.memmove(source, b'x', 1)
            if type(data) is int:
                return data
            ctypes.memmove(output, data, len(data))
            return len(data)
        image._entry = entry
        return image

            with self.assertRaises(HIAProgramRejected):

        for altered in ({'ops': [{}]}, {'flags': [True]}, {'final': 8}):
            with self.assertRaises(HIAProgramRejected):

        context = self.context('task.start', 1)
        for query in ({}, {'type': -1, 'operation': 'start'}, {'type': 0, 'operation': 'close'}):
            with self.assertRaises(HIAProgramRejected):

    def compare_at_tasks(self, document, *, variations=None, serials=(0, 8187, 8188, 8190, 8191, 8192), prepare=None, native_helpers=None):
        """Compare the retained branch and full owner including failed helper cache.

        Existing closures observe the real env/ops objects, restored in place.
        Every run records owner callbacks, helper functions/names, type caches,
        flags, bindings, counter and instruction prefix, including exceptions.
        """
        case, observations = self, []
        reference = composite._Elaborator._reference_task_operation
        selected = composite._Elaborator.lower_task_operation
        def freeze(value):
            if isinstance(value, composite._Type):
                return ('type', value.key)
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                return tuple((key, freeze(item)) for key, item in sorted(value.items()))
            if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
                return tuple(freeze(item) for item in value)
            return value
        def compare(owner, ins, actual, declared, env, ops, consume, outputs):
            initial_serial, initial_env, initial_ops = owner.serial, dict(env), deepcopy(ops)
            held = {id(item): (item, item.consumed) for item in [*env.values(), *actual]}
            choices = [(deepcopy(ins), actual, declared)]
            if variations:
                choices.extend(variations(owner, ins, actual, declared))
            saved_cache, saved_active = dict(owner.types.cache), set(owner.types.active)
            saved_loans, saved_steps = dict(owner.types.known_loan_cache), owner.types.partial_declaration_steps
            saved_helpers, saved_names = deepcopy(owner.helpers), dict(owner.helper_names)
            saved_functions, saved_signatures = dict(owner.functions), dict(owner.signatures)
            def restore():
                env.clear(); env.update(initial_env); ops[:] = deepcopy(initial_ops)
                for item, consumed in held.values():
                    item.consumed = consumed
                owner.types.cache.clear(); owner.types.cache.update(saved_cache)
                owner.types.active.clear(); owner.types.active.update(saved_active)
                owner.types.known_loan_cache.clear(); owner.types.known_loan_cache.update(saved_loans)
                owner.types.partial_declaration_steps = saved_steps
                owner.helper_names.clear(); owner.helper_names.update(saved_names)
                owner.helpers[:] = deepcopy(saved_helpers)
                owner.functions.clear(); owner.functions.update(saved_functions)
                owner.signatures.clear(); owner.signatures.update(saved_signatures)
            def observed(call):
                trace = []
                methods = {name: getattr(owner, name) for name in ('parameters', 'check_task', 'helper')}
                resolve = owner.types.resolve
                def tracked(name):
                    def invoke(*args, **kwargs):
                        trace.append((name, freeze(args), owner.serial,
                            tuple((key, value.consumed) for key, value in env.items()), len(ops)))
                        return methods[name](*args, **kwargs)
                    return invoke
                def tracked_resolve(*args, **kwargs):
                    trace.append(('resolve', freeze(args), owner.serial))
                    return resolve(*args, **kwargs)
                with patch.object(owner.types, 'resolve', side_effect=tracked_resolve), patch.object(
                        owner, 'parameters', side_effect=tracked('parameters')), patch.object(
                        owner, 'check_task', side_effect=tracked('check_task')), patch.object(
                        owner, 'helper', side_effect=tracked('helper')):
                    _, error = outcome(call)
                snapshot = {name: (freeze(item.typ), item.names, item.external, item.consumed)
                            for name, item in env.items()}
                return (error, owner.serial, deepcopy(ops), snapshot, trace, freeze(owner.types.cache),
                        owner.types.partial_declaration_steps, freeze(owner.types.known_loan_cache),
                        dict(owner.helper_names), deepcopy(owner.helpers))
            for changed, values, declarations in choices:
                for serial in serials:
                    # Counter injection is a test boundary. Clear existing
                    # helpers so their generated names cannot lie in its future.
                    restore(); owner.serial = serial; owner.helpers.clear(); owner.helper_names.clear()
                    if prepare:
                        prepare(owner, changed, actual, env)
                    expected = observed(lambda: reference(owner, changed, values, declarations,
                        env, ops, consume, outputs))
                    restore(); owner.serial = serial; owner.helpers.clear(); owner.helper_names.clear()
                    if prepare:
                        prepare(owner, changed, actual, env)
                    with patch('hepta.hia_task_operations_native.selected_task_operations', return_value=case.native), patch(
                            'hepta.hia_task_helpers_native.selected_task_helpers', return_value=native_helpers):
                        native = observed(lambda: selected(owner, changed, values, declarations,
                            env, ops, consume, outputs))
                    case.assertEqual(native, expected, (changed, serial))
                    observations.append((changed['op'], expected[0], serial, expected[1],
                        len(expected[2]) - len(initial_ops), expected[3], expected[4], expected[8], expected[9]))
            restore(); owner.serial = initial_serial
            return reference(owner, ins, actual, declared, env, ops, consume, outputs)
        with patch.object(composite._Elaborator, 'lower_task_operation', compare):
            _, original_error = outcome(lambda: verify_core(document))
        self.assertTrue(observations, 'fixture must reach real task lowering')
        return observations, original_error

        return tuple(result)
    if value is None or type(value) in (str, bytes, int, bool, float):
        return type(value), value
    return _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING


def _source_same_protocol(function, reference):
    if type(function) is not _source_types.FunctionType:
        return False
    actual, expected = function.__code__, reference.__code__
    # Names/qualnames, source positions and docstring spelling do not govern
    # these fixed binary I/O and lexical path operations. Executable bytecode,
    # exception regions, constants and signatures do.
    actual_constants = _source_code_constants(actual.co_consts[1:])
    expected_constants = _source_code_constants(expected.co_consts[1:])
    if actual_constants is _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING or expected_constants is _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING:
        return False
    actual_kw, expected_kw = function.__kwdefaults__, reference.__kwdefaults__
    if actual_kw is not None:
        if type(actual_kw) is not dict or any(type(key) is not str for key in actual_kw):
            return False
        actual_kw = _source_code_constants(tuple(sorted(actual_kw.items())))
        if actual_kw is _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING:
            return False
    if expected_kw is not None:
        expected_kw = _source_code_constants(tuple(sorted(expected_kw.items())))
    fields = ('co_code', 'co_exceptiontable', 'co_names', 'co_varnames',
              'co_freevars', 'co_cellvars', 'co_argcount', 'co_posonlyargcount',
              'co_kwonlyargcount', 'co_nlocals', 'co_stacksize')
    return (all(getattr(actual, name) == getattr(expected, name) for name in fields)
            and actual_constants == expected_constants
            and _source_code_constants(function.__defaults__)
                == _source_code_constants(reference.__defaults__)
            and actual_kw == expected_kw)


def _source_static_member(cls, name):
    for parent in cls.__mro__:
        namespace = parent.__dict__
        if name in namespace:
            return namespace[name]
    return _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING


def _source_capture_protocol():
    # This is an immutable protocol identity, never a path/file/digest cache.
    # Unknown runtimes or pre-import provider replacements use the original
    # public Path protocol. Both reviewed read_bytes buffer modes are explicit.
    path_class, concrete = _source_pathlib.Path, _source_pathlib.PosixPath
    if type(path_class) is not type or type(concrete) is not type:
        return None
    if type(_source_io) is not _source_types.ModuleType:
        return None
    opened = _source_io.__dict__.get('open')
    if (type(opened) is not _source_types.BuiltinFunctionType
            or opened.__module__ != '_io' or opened.__name__ != 'open'
            or type(sha256) is not _source_types.BuiltinFunctionType
            or sha256.__module__ != '_hashlib' or sha256.__name__ != 'openssl_sha256'):
        return None
    functions = []
    names = ('read_bytes', 'open', '__truediv__', 'as_posix', 'relative_to',
             '__fspath__', '__str__', 'joinpath', 'with_segments')
    buffering = None
    for name in names:
        function = _source_static_member(concrete, name)
        matches = [profile for profile in (_SourcePathProtocol312, _SourcePathProtocol314)
                   if _source_same_protocol(function, profile.__dict__[name])]
        if not matches:
            return None
        if name == 'read_bytes':
            buffering = -1 if _SourcePathProtocol312 in matches else 0
        kw = function.__kwdefaults__
        if kw is not None and (type(kw) is not dict or any(type(k) is not str for k in kw)):
            return None
        functions.append((name, function, function.__code__, function.__defaults__,
                          kw, tuple(kw.items()) if kw is not None else ()))
    if _source_static_member(concrete, 'open').__globals__.get('io') is not _source_io:
        return None
    classes = []
    for cls in concrete.__mro__:
        if cls is object:
            continue
        namespace = cls.__dict__
        # Reject foreign descriptors/methods before freezing their identities.
        for value in namespace.values():
            function = value.__func__ if type(value) in (classmethod, staticmethod) else value
            if type(function) is _source_types.FunctionType:
                if (function.__globals__ is not _source_pathlib.__dict__
                        or function.__code__.co_filename != _source_pathlib.__file__):
                    return None
        classes.append((cls, len(namespace), tuple((name, namespace.get(name, _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING))
                                                 for name in names)))
    return (path_class, concrete, opened, sha256, buffering, tuple(classes), tuple(functions))


_SOURCE_PATH_PROTOCOL = _source_capture_protocol()


def _source_protocol_current(root):
    protocol = _SOURCE_PATH_PROTOCOL
    if protocol is None or Path is not protocol[0] or type(root) is not protocol[1]:
        return False
    if (type(_source_io) is not _source_types.ModuleType
            or _source_io.__dict__.get('open') is not protocol[2]
            or sha256 is not protocol[3]):
        return False
    for cls, length, members in protocol[5]:
        namespace = cls.__dict__
        if len(namespace) != length:
            return False
        for name, value in members:
            if namespace.get(name, _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING) is not value:
                return False
    for name, function, code, defaults, kw, items in protocol[6]:
        if function.__code__ is not code or function.__defaults__ is not defaults:
            return False
        if function.__kwdefaults__ is not kw:
            return False
        if kw is not None:
            if len(kw) != len(items) or any(type(key) is not str for key in kw):
                return False
            if any(kw.get(key, _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING) is not value for key, value in items):
                return False
    return _source_static_member(protocol[1], 'open').__globals__.get('io') is _source_io


def _source_relative_name(path, root, prefix):
    # A foreign path executes the original expression in the caller's set
    # comprehension; this helper neither calls nor retains its protocol.
    if type(path) is not type(root) or not _source_protocol_current(root):
        return None
    full = path.as_posix()
    if prefix:
        if full.startswith(prefix) and len(full) > len(prefix):
            return full[len(prefix):]
    elif not full.startswith('/'):
        return full
    return None


def _source_lexical_read(root, relative, prefix):
    # Recheck mutable public providers at each read, including replacements
    # introduced by an earlier file's audit hook/hash operation. Exact bytes
    # leave this frame before sha256; close always precedes hashing.
    if (type(relative) is str and relative and not relative.startswith('/')
            and not relative.endswith('/') and '//' not in relative
            and relative != '.' and not relative.startswith('./')
            and not relative.endswith('/.') and '/./' not in relative
            and _source_protocol_current(root)):
        with _source_io.open(prefix + relative, 'rb', buffering=_SOURCE_PATH_PROTOCOL[4]) as stream:
            return stream.read()
    return (root / relative).read_bytes()


def file_digests(root=ROOT):
    root = Path(root)
    # The original expression remains the full provider fallback. No path
    # inventory, source bytes or digest survives any invocation of this API.
    if (not _source_protocol_current(root) or type(SOURCE_FILES) is not tuple
            or any(type(name) is not str for name in SOURCE_FILES)):
        paths = sorted(set(SOURCE_FILES) | {
            p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in (root / "hepta").rglob("*.py")
        })
        return {path: sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in paths}
    declared = set(SOURCE_FILES)
    root_name = root.as_posix()
    prefix = '' if root_name == '.' else root_name if root_name.endswith('/') else root_name + '/'
    paths = sorted(declared | {
        name if (name := _source_relative_name(p, root, prefix)) is not None
        else p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        for p in (root / "hepta").rglob("*.py")
    })
    return {path: sha256(_source_lexical_read(root, path, prefix)).hexdigest() for path in paths}

class CampaignRejected(ValueError):
    pass


class CampaignBudgetExceeded(CampaignRejected):
    pass


def _require(condition, reason):
    if not condition:
        raise CampaignRejected(reason)


def _json(raw):
    def pairs(items):
        result = {}
        for key, value in items:
            _require(key not in result, "duplicate JSON key")
            result[key] = value
        return result
    try:
        return json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=pairs,
            parse_constant=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(CampaignRejected("nonfinite JSON")))
    except (ValueError, UnicodeError, RecursionError) as exc:
        raise CampaignRejected("invalid receipt JSON") from exc


def _read_regular(path, maximum=MAX_OBJECT_BYTES, *, allow_hardlinks=False):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
    try:
        before = os.fstat(fd)
        _require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and (allow_hardlinks or before.st_nlink == 1),
                 "receipt must be a single-link regular file")
        _require(before.st_size <= maximum, "receipt byte bound exceeded")
        chunks, size = [], 0
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, min(65536, maximum + 1 - size))
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
            size += len(block)
            _require(size <= maximum, "receipt grew beyond byte bound")
        after = os.fstat(fd)
        _require((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns,
                  before.st_ctime_ns) == (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size,
                  after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_ctime_ns), "receipt changed while reading")
        return b"".join(chunks)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def _new_file(path, raw):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb", closefd=False) as stream:
            stream.write(raw)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


class Evidence:
    """Content-addressed original bytes; no executable or uploaded receipts."""
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = Path(root)
        self.root.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
        (self.root / "objects").mkdir(mode=0o700)
        self.inventory = {}
        self.byte_size = 0

    def put(self, value, *, binary=False):
        raw = value if binary else wire(value)
        _require(type(raw) is bytes and len(raw) <= MAX_OBJECT_BYTES, "object byte bound exceeded")
        identity = sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        if identity not in self.inventory:
            _require(len(self.inventory) < MAX_OBJECTS, "object count bound exceeded")
            _require(self.byte_size + len(raw) <= MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES, "bundle byte bound exceeded")
            _new_file(self.root / "objects" / identity, raw)
            self.inventory[identity] = {"sha256": identity, "byte_size": len(raw)}
            self.byte_size += len(raw)
        return identity

    def named(self, name, value):
        _new_file(self.root / name, wire(value) + b"\n")


class CapturingSession(Session):
    """Retain actual hia_read bytes, including receipt dependency closure."""
    def __init__(self, client, evidence, *, prefix):
        self.evidence = evidence
        self.captured = set()
        super().__init__(client, prefix=prefix)

    def read(self, artifact, **kwargs):
        raw = super().read(artifact, **kwargs)
        self.evidence.put(raw, binary=True)
        self.captured.add(artifact["sha256"])
        return raw

    def harvest(self, value):
        queue = [value]
        while queue:
            item = queue.pop()
            if type(item) is dict:
                if set(item) == {"id", "sha256", "uri"} and item["sha256"] not in self.captured:
                    raw = self.read(item)
                    try:
                        queue.append(_json(raw))
                    except CampaignRejected:
                        pass  # Native artifacts are retained as original bytes.
                else:
                    queue.extend(item.values())
            elif type(item) is list:
                queue.extend(item)


class Journal:
    """One contiguous outer wall interval per attempt, including evidence work.

    Serialization after one attempt is charged to the following interval. The
    final close event sets the measurement endpoint. Exporting that final event
    and verdict is outside the endpoint and separately reported at campaign
    level. Nested tool/native timings are evidence, never extra charge entries.
    """
    def __init__(self, evidence, arm, task, budget, *, clock=time.monotonic_ns):
        self.evidence, self.arm, self.task, self.budget = evidence, arm, task, budget
        self.clock = clock
        self.origin = self.cursor = clock()
        self.entries = []
        self.client = self.session = None
        self.closed = False

    def run(self, phase, label, operation, *, expected_status="completed", cleanup=False, model=False):
        _require(not self.closed, "journal already closed")
        operation_start = self.clock()
        start = self.cursor
        record_start = len(self.client.records) if self.client else 0
        value, failure, status = None, None, expected_status
        try:
            if not cleanup and operation_start - self.origin >= self.budget["wall_ns"]:
                raise CampaignBudgetExceeded("original task wall allowance exhausted")
            value = operation()
            if self.session is not None:
                self.session.harvest(value)
                self.session.harvest(self.client.records[record_start:])
        except Exception as exc:
            failure = {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)[:2048]}
            status = "failed"
        if model and value is not None and value.get("status") != "completed":
            status = "failed"
            failure = failure or {"type": "ProviderIncomplete", "message": value.get("reason", value.get("error") or value["status"])}
        end = self.clock()
        records = deepcopy(self.client.records[record_start:]) if self.client else []
        event = {"schema": EVENT_SCHEMA, "arm": self.arm, "task_id": self.task,
            "id": f"event.{len(self.entries):04d}", "phase": phase, "label": label,
            "status": status, "start_offset_ns": start - self.origin,
            "operation_start_offset_ns": operation_start - self.origin,
            "end_offset_ns": end - self.origin, "wall_ns": end - start,
            "model_tokens": ((value.get("charged_model_tokens") if value is not None else None) if model else 0),
            "output": value, "failure": failure, "tool_records": records,
            "nested_tool_costs_charged_separately": False}
        receipt = self.evidence.put(event)
        self.entries.append({key: event[key] for key in ("id", "phase", "status", "wall_ns", "model_tokens")}
                            | {"receipt_sha256": receipt})
        self.cursor = end
        if failure:
            raise CampaignRejected(f"{phase}/{label}: {failure['type']}: {failure['message']}")
        return value

    def close(self, operation=lambda: None):
        try:
            self.run("controller", "close measurement interval", operation, cleanup=True)
        finally:
            self.closed = True

    def phase_inventory(self):
        return {phase: {"performed": any(entry["phase"] == phase for entry in self.entries),
            "receipt_sha256": self.evidence.put({"schema": "hepta.hia.agent.macro-phase.v1",
                "arm": self.arm, "task_id": self.task, "phase": phase,
                "event_receipts": [entry["receipt_sha256"] for entry in self.entries if entry["phase"] == phase],
                "not_performed_reason": (None if any(entry["phase"] == phase for entry in self.entries)
                    else "not invoked by this deterministic fixture; no Agent/provider cost is inferred")})}
            for phase in sorted(PHASES)}

def _worker_sources(evidence):
    from hepta.hia_agent_contract import (DISCOVERY_FILES, NATIVE_SOURCE_FILES,
        SOURCE_BUILD_FILES, COMPILER_BUILD_FILES, PUBLICATION_BUILD_FILES,
        BACKEND_BUILD_FILES, EMITTER_BUILD_FILES, BYTE_WRAPPER_BUILD_FILES, MACHINE_OBJECT_BUILD_FILES, EXECUTION_OBSERVATION_BUILD_FILES, CONTINUATION_BUILD_FILES)
    paths = [path for path in sorted((ROOT / "hepta").rglob("*.py"))
             if path.relative_to(ROOT / "hepta").parts[0] != "_data"]
    paths += [ROOT / "docs" / name for name in DISCOVERY_FILES]
    paths += [ROOT / name for name in (*NATIVE_SOURCE_FILES, *SOURCE_BUILD_FILES,
                                      *COMPILER_BUILD_FILES, *PUBLICATION_BUILD_FILES,
                                      *BACKEND_BUILD_FILES, *EMITTER_BUILD_FILES, *BYTE_WRAPPER_BUILD_FILES, *MACHINE_OBJECT_BUILD_FILES, *EXECUTION_OBSERVATION_BUILD_FILES, *CONTINUATION_BUILD_FILES)]
    entries = {}
    for path in paths:
        name = str(path.relative_to(ROOT))
        identity = evidence.put(_read_regular(path), binary=True)
        _require(name not in entries or entries[name] == identity,
                 "worker module and source resource differ")
        entries[name] = identity
    return entries
